pm_structure.summary: General account managed in-house by Beneva's investment team under a Board-approved investment policy; private markets accessed through external fund managers; Board Investment Committee oversight.
manager_entities: Beneva Investment Services Inc. (fund dealer subsidiary)
Beneva Real Estate Management Inc. (property management)
bullets: Results release: carbon intensity of 'the internally managed portfolio' down 39% vs 2021 - confirms in-house management (Apr 2026).
Investment policy approved by Board; compliance checked monthly; deviations and return-to-compliance plans to Board quarterly (AR note 7).
Investment Committee of the Board carries out regular reviews of the portfolio and its transactions (AR note 7).
Private debt and private-company investments (C$1.5bn) valued using values published by external managers, i.e. fund/LP structures (AR note 6).
Investments segmented by line of business and surplus for matching; FVTPL designation used for matching assets (AR note 3).
C$7.1bn of general-fund 'mutual funds' - a substantial portion of returns accrue to policyholders (UL/investment accounts) (AR note 7).

rotation_commentary.text: Private-company investments rose to C$1,533.9mm from 1,330.6 (purchases 253.9): private debt funds 484.2, infrastructure equity 458.6, real estate 355.4, other 235.7.
Private debt designated FVTPL 284.9 (2024: 290.9); weighted average effective rates: bonds 4.0%, private debt 5.7% (2024: 6.4%), loans 4.0%.
Over C$2.955bn of general-fund investments in green bonds, energy transition, renewables, social infrastructure and sustainable buildings; carbon intensity -39% vs 2021.
Mutual-fund holdings in the general fund grew to C$7,079.9mm from 6,325.8 (equity funds 4,055.9; diversified 2,745.2) on market gains and UL deposits.
Gore Mutual (P&C) merged Jan 1, 2026; Gore's general account joins Beneva's; integration with Unica over 2026.

securities_lending.text: Loaned securities (carrying amount) 1,050.5 (2024: 1,069.6); collateral of at least 102% of fair value held by custodian; monitored daily.

structured_indirect.text: Private debt funds (external managers) 484.2 and infrastructure-related private debt; no CLO/ABS, NAV or fund-finance exposure disclosed.
Derivatives: FX forwards, equity index futures, swaps supporting L&H liabilities; FV asset 42.2, liability cash outflows 305.3 (undiscounted); ISDA/GMRA collateral.

deals.text: SSQ Insurance and La Capitale merge to form Beneva, Canada's largest insurance mutual (legal amalgamation completed 2023).
Jan 21, 2025: Beneva and Gore Mutual (Cambridge, ON, P&C) announce merger; member votes, Competition Bureau and private bills in Senate and Quebec National Assembly.
Jan 1, 2026: merger completed; Gore Mutual becomes Gore Insurance Company, a Beneva subsidiary; Andy Taylor named EVP P&C Ontario & West. Advisers not named.
Acquired an interest in a 'multidisciplinary financial services firm' (associate); associates also include P&C brokerages.

sponsorships.text: Title partner of Beneva Montreal Marathon (32,500 runners), Beneva Quebec City Marathon (17,000), Beneva Spring Run-Off (Toronto), Beneva Mississauga Marathon; presenting partner Defi Entreprises.
Title partner, Vancouver Half Marathon (Canada Running Series), announced Nov 27, 2025.
Official partner, UCI Road World Championships Montreal 2026 (announced Dec 1, 2025).
Renewed partnerships with Videotron Centre, Quebec Remparts (QMJHL) and Quebec City Marathon (Dec 2024).
Renewed partnership with the Montreal Alouettes (CFL).

bank_relationships.text: Fonds de solidarite FTQ is co-shareholder of Beneva Group Inc. alongside Beneva Mutual (50.7%); several directors are ex-FTQ executives.
Cash and cash in trust invested with Canadian chartered banks; derivative counterparties under ISDA/GMRA with collateral.

appetite: Board sets risk tolerance; policies approved by Board, monitored by committees (AR note 7).
Credit limits: corporate bonds max 40% (L&H) / 80% (P&C) of bond+MM portfolio; min rating B (DBRS); issuer, sector, geographic limits.
No derivatives used for speculation; FX hedging of foreign debt/equity/mutual funds.
Reinsurers minimum A- (AM Best); risk adjustment confidence level 75-80%.
governance: Risk Management function identifies/quantifies all risks; VP Risk Management Michel Fournier functionally reports to Board Risk, Ethics and IT Management Committee.
Board Investment Committee reviews portfolio and transactions; audit committees liaise with other committees; Internal Audit (Josee Grondines) reports to Audit Committee.
Appointed Actuary runs annual FCT for Beneva Inc. and each insurance subsidiary; 5-year capital forecasts incl. CARLI/MCT filed with AMF.
risk.capital_target: Internal CARLI (Beneva Inc.) and MCT (P&C subs) targets above AMF minimums; levels not disclosed. Reported CARLI 163% (2025) vs 150% (2024).
sensitivities: Equity -15% (common shares/mutual funds, ex policyholder pass-through): net income -74.7, OCI -1.8 (2025).
Equity -15% on fee/guarantee exposure (seg funds, UL): CSM -63.7, net income -14.6 (2025).
Currency: mainly USD; hedged with forwards. Private assets: no sensitivity performed (external manager values).
hedging: FX forwards hedge currency on foreign debt, equity and mutual fund holdings; equity index futures and swaps support L&H liabilities; cash-flow matching by line of business.
events: Gore Mutual merger closed Jan 1, 2026 (P&C); Unica integration 2026.
2025: tariff/geopolitical and climate risks flagged as emerging risks; Risk function monitors.
2025 P&C results helped by milder weather than 2024.

gaps: Mutual: no proxy circular; executive compensation not disclosed for any officer.
No named Chief Investment Officer or head of fixed income/private markets on management team page or in AR; investments team headcount not disclosed.
Exact FTQ stake in Beneva Group Inc. not disclosed (Beneva Mutual 50.7%; remainder via Fonds de solidarite FTQ / Societe financiere Beneva).
No quarterly reporting; latest figures are FY2025 (Dec 31, 2025); no LTM/YTD 2026.
Core CARLI ratio and internal capital target range not disclosed.
Beneva has no public debt, so no issuance/bookrunner history.
Web search budget exhausted before confirming 2025/2026 AM Best affirmation press release; rating taken from the FY2025 annual report.
notes: The 2025 annual report (79 PDF pages, two report pages per PDF page) contains Beneva Mutual's statements plus the full consolidated statements of Beneva Group Inc./Beneva Inc. Beneva Inc. is the AMF-regulated L&H insurer that also owns the P&C subsidiaries (Beneva Insurance Co., L'Unique, Unica, Gore). Segment net income percentages computed from AR figures (96.4+275.1+113.0+189.3=673.8).
